summary: Backend-only testing for P0 fix: manual labour_cess=0 must persist and not be recomputed. Wrote pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_labour_cess_manual_iter56.py covering: (1) /api/calculator/price with labour_cess_manual + labour_cess_override (values 0, 12345, absent, and manual-without-override fallback); (2) PUT /api/customers/{id} persistence of labour_cess=0 + labour_cess_manual=true on Ramya test lead (6d902613-5106-4294-bc3e-b907f85127f7) verified via GET; (3) POST /api/documents/generate price_breakup HTML shows Labour Cess with ₹0.00 row; (4) POST /api/calculator/generate-schedule/{id} still returns 13 items summing to preserved 211655.79 even with labour_cess=0. All 8 tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: payments/routes.py calculate_price fallback logic: if labour_cess_manual=true but labour_cess_override is None it silently falls back to formula. Consider raising 422 or logging a warning to help catch frontend bugs where the toggle is on but the value wasn't sent.

PriceCalculation.labour_cess_override is Optional[float] and defaults to None — good; but there's no server-side validation that override is non-negative. A negative override would flow through unchanged.

seed_data_creation: None. Test mutates Ramya test lead (labour_cess, labour_cess_manual) and restores original values after the persistence test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Response shapes verified: /api/calculator/generate-schedule/{id} returns {message, schedule:{items:[...], ...}} (13 items for Ramya legacy). /api/documents/generate returns HTML under one of: 'html', 'content', 'html_content', or nested document.{html,content}. Ramya's preserved total_price=211655.79. Auth uses 'access_token' key in login response (with 'token' fallback in the fixture).
rca of the issue: P0 bug root cause was in /api/calculator/price which unconditionally computed labour_cess = subtotal * labour_cess_percentage / 100, ignoring any manual override. The customer PUT endpoint had no recompute logic, but the calculator was still being called elsewhere (booking form + tests). Fix (already applied by E1) adds labour_cess_manual + labour_cess_override to PriceCalculation model and gates the auto-formula on them in routes.py lines 372-381. Verified persistence via GET after PUT and via price_breakup document HTML rendering ₹0.00.
